purpose: Scores a Swift member's declared architecture type and component inventory against a policy-supplied Swift CSCF control matrix. Returns applicable mandatory/advisory control set, coverage percentages, a gap list keyed by control number, an evidence index mapped to the matrix's supporting-evidence column, and an explicit not-applicable set with a stated reason per exclusion.
